description: Per-frame update of a player's three tint colour channels: ease levels to requested/default and add a sine wobble to the up/down bytes
Emits gDPSetPrimColor/gDPSetEnvColor from a player's tint up/down bytes (D_800D9F88 / D_800D9F98) with the given alphas
Resolves texture ids in a display list's G_SETTIMG commands to cache addresses (with palette offsets); optionally builds an id list
Texture cache lookup: returns the expanded data of a texture id, DMAing and decompressing it on a miss; updates age and refcount
ROM offset of a texture's compressed block: base D_1A3B40 plus the sum of the compressed sizes of all lower ids
Per-frame texture cache ageing: counts down ages of pending slots and frees them at 0, re-expands slots flagged 0x40
Sets a cached texture's age to a new value, keeping its 0x40 flag (no-op when the slot is empty)
Releases every texture id of an s16 id list {n, ids...} (func_1510DC14) and frees the list

Clears the list of segment override entries (D_800DA2F0 = 0)
Adds a segment override entry (key, two addresses, two segment numbers) to the 8-entry list D_800DA2F8
Emits G_MOVEWORD segment commands (0xDB06) for every override entry whose key matches; returns the advanced display list
Allocates a blob shadow record node (type 0x4B) for an owner, initialising its vertex UVs, owner kind, texture index and flags

Emits a blob shadow's display list: translation matrix to the floor point, texture, prim alpha and two triangles
Computes the floor plane slope (dy/dx, dy/dz) of a triangle given as vertex pointers or packed s16 vertices; 0 when degenerate
Emits a gSPMatrix loading the fixed matrix D_80089810 into the modelview (no push)
Says whether collision candidate i (D_800D3720) faces up: cross product of its triangle edges has a non-negative y
Floor lookup wrapper around func_1510EED0 with no ceiling-vertex output and caller-given object y range
Floor lookup wrapper around func_1510EED0 with no ceiling-vertex output and the default object y range (-10000..20000)
Floor lookup wrapper around func_1510EED0 with the default object y range and a caller-given no-fallback flag
Floor/ceiling lookup under (x, z) over the 4 collision areas; outputs floor triangle, vertices, heights, flags and area
Selects the collision area for the following candidate queries (wraps func_150A4ED4)
Floor height under (x, z) among world objects (collision area 2) near y; -10000 when none
Collects the leaf zones of the D_800DC278 zone tree within a margin of (x, z) into a list; returns the count
Walks the D_800DC278 zone tree to the leaf zone whose square contains (x, z); 0 when none
Gets a triangle's floor slope (func_1510E908) and its direction normalised to 50x the slope length
Returns the surface type bits (flags & 0x1F) of a floor flag word
Level-tree floor height under (x, z) nearest to y (preferring heights below); optionally returns the triangle

Index of a leaf zone in the D_800DC278 zone tree (counting sibling steps); 0 when not found
Per-view background pass: clears tint bytes, draws the screen border/fill, then calls the level's camera/sky callback with wrapped angles
Builds a rotation matrix from yaw, pitch and roll (three func_150A8050 rotations multiplied together)
Rotation matrix (yaw, pitch, roll) multiplied by camera record's matrix (+0xBC) of the given camera
Default camera callback: fills the player's viewport with the level colour and draws split-screen divider bars from player 0
Emits fill-mode setup and a filled rectangle in an RGB colour (converted to RGBA5551)
Camera callback: on levels 0x1B / 0x1E (and 0x31 in a state) fills the screen inset by 2 pixels with the level colour
For player 0 only: clears the colour image with a fill rectangle and draws split-screen divider bars
Per-level sky distance/visibility value from the camera position and angle (0 = sky hidden), passed to the sky callback
Builds one face of the sky box as a grid of textured quads in the vertex buffer and queues their texture loads
Switches the camera overlay mode/id: frees the old overlay asset and textures, loads the new asset or generates stars
Allocates the overlay buffer and fills it with 8000 random stars on a sphere (position, brightness, colour)
Camera callback drawing the textured sky box of the current player: view matrix, visible faces, texture loads, triangles
World object callback: turns the object's yaw/pitch toward player 0 within range (rate limited), playing a turn sound

Sets flag 0x40 of +0x6F on world-object records that have a callback (+0x38) and are visible/flagged; clears it on others
Per-frame matrix pass over the visible world-object records (position/orientation, following objects, fallback)
Draws the visible world mesh list of a player: geometry setup, light block, one world_mesh draw per entry, matrix pop
Draws one world mesh record for a player: alpha fade, render mode, colour, segments, matrix and the mesh display list
Creates or destroys the blob shadow node (+0x94) of each world-object record depending on its visibility and flags
Runs the update callback of every pending world-object record, copying group leader positions to members first
Says whether a world-object record (flag 0x80) is touched by object index arg1 (-1 = any) via D_800DC3C4
Returns the lowest object index whose bit is set in a touched world-object record's D_800DC3C4 mask; 0 when none
For every world-object record touched by objects, calls its touch callback (+0x78) per object and updates carried objects
Rotates a point by a world-object record's angles around its pivot and adds the record's offset delta
Refreshes a carried object's position by its world-object record and advances its timer (+0x76) by the record speed
Builds the base rotation matrix of a world-object record from its three f32 angles (+0, +4, +8)

Returns the world-object record whose id byte (+0x72) equals id, or NULL; id 0 never matches
Per-frame release of world-object record blocks (D_800DC328), immediately or after a frame countdown
Hides a world-object record (destroying its shadow) and trims hidden records off the end of the table
Positional sound callback: copies the world object's position into the voice; returns 1 when it has no object
Plays, updates or stops the positional sound of a world object according to flags (one-shot, tracked, restart)
Sets volume and pitch (cents) of the tracked positional sound of a world object (func_1001001C keyed by its callback)
On levels 0x12 / 0x13 / 0x36 validates the triangle pointer tables (crashes on a bad pointer) and stores three values
Empty world mesh handler (does nothing)

Scenery handler: turns angle +0x4 by speed (high half of +0x3C / 256 per tick), wrapped into [0, 360); rate in +0x64

Empty world mesh handler (does nothing; second copy)

Scenery handler: platform that shakes after a delay while stood on, then falls and hides; respawns when player 0 is far away
Scenery handler: moves y between its rest height and a target in equal steps with pauses (lift); +0x5C gets the y change
Scenery handler: when stood on, moves the object from its rest position to an offset over time, waits, then returns, with sounds
Touch handler: adds the toucher's position relative to the object (rotated by its yaw) to the push accumulators +0x7C/+0x80 while stood on

Scenery handler: keeps y on the object floor below plus an offset that dips while stood on (bobbing float)

Speed update of a drifting platform pushed by the player, decaying to rest, with a looping pitch-varying sound
Push amount of an object on a platform: its speed (+0x3C) times the sine of its heading relative to the platform direction
Empty world mesh touch handler (does nothing)
Touch handler: while stood on and closed, opens the mover (state 2) when the player's +0x57 action flag is 1
Scenery handler: runs scenery_mover_step while state bit 2 (opening) of +0x73 is set
Moves the object's position toward its target with move/stop sounds; near-arrival sound entries go to func_1511712C
Mover step for sound entries with a near-arrival sound: steps toward the target and plays the arrival sound once
Scenery handler: three angles turn by their rates, each rate easing toward its target rate; angles wrapped to [0, 360)
Per-frame vertex morph of a mesh between keyframes loaded from ROM; position eases toward its target
Spring-damped swing of one angle toward its rest angle, with a start sound; returns the new angle

Scenery handler: spring swing of angle +0x4 (scenery_swing_angle_step)
Scenery handler: spring swing of angle +0x0 (scenery_swing_angle_step)
Bouncing pendulum step of one angle toward its rest angle, with a start sound; returns the new angle
Scenery handler: pendulum swing of angle +0x0 (scenery_pendulum_angle_step)
Scenery handler: pendulum swing of angle +0x8 (scenery_pendulum_angle_step)

Scenery handler: slides along its rotated local axis to an offset when opening, waits a time, then slides back
Touch handler: a player standing on a closed mover opens it (state 2), if no action is needed or the action flag is 1
Transforms a local point (x, y, z) by a scenery record's angles +0x0 / +0x4 and position into a world point
Per-level push gate/door handler: players near the handle push it open with a delay, sound and swing; swings shut otherwise
Scenery handler: door swing (scenery_mover_swing_step) with pass-through argument 0
Scenery handler: door swing (scenery_mover_swing_step) with pass-through argument 3
Swings a world mesh record about its yaw like a door through its open/close states, with sounds and light dimming
Per-frame swing of a hanging object toward its rest angle with gravity, bounces, thud sounds and light slot dimming
Touch handler: a player toucher (type 1, +0x65 == 0) opens the closed mover (state 2)
Scenery handler: moves y toward base + phase * amplitude / 256 at a limited speed, setting the arrived bits at the target
Recursively tags the mesh vertices connected (via the display list triangles) to a seed vertex outside a radius with a cluster tag
Splits a mesh's vertices into connected clusters and rotates each cluster in the x/z plane, re-tagging its vertices
Per-frame update of a clustered flapping mesh (petals): bends groups by angle, closes when the player is near
Spinning, bobbing pickup handler: fades in by player distance, gives the item on touch, respawns or is marked taken
Finds the first two texture markers (0xFD commands) in a display list; returns the first index, the second via the out pointer
Steps the animated texture of a scenery object from the D_800896C4 table and patches the frame into its display list
Scenery handler: starts the pending animation (if any) and steps the object's animated texture
Scenery handler: bobs the object (reset when netplay says so) and steps its animated texture
Starts a wave on a wobbling mesh: resets the wave state (angle, amplitude 260, speed 100) and the per-vertex heights
Per-frame update of a wobbling mesh: per-vertex circling phases, waves, matrix transform into the vertex buffer
Scenery handler: eases angle +0x0 to a base tilt from +0x3C, then adds random jitter smoothed over time
Per-frame update of a sliding door/gate by type: opens/closes along x/z with eased speed and start/stop sounds
Swings a door angle (+0x8) through its open/close states with bounce and settling; drives a light slot by the open fraction
Rotates a part's template vertices around two reference objects by their yaws into the current vertex buffer
Scenery handler: sets the alpha +0x8A from the value func_15188580 returns for id +0x3C (times 255, at least 1)
Offsets a mesh's texture coordinates by a tracked (x, z) position relative to the object, scaled; caches the source UVs once
Scenery handler: projects the mesh texture to follow an object (+0x80, or the one found by id +0x3F)
Sets the object's yaw (+0x4) to face the player 0 camera position (billboard yaw)
Billboard handler with a player-ridden lift on level 0xA: moves y up/down with start/stop sounds while a player rides it
Empty function (does nothing)
Scenery handler: sways angles +0x0 / +0x8 by 16 * sin of two phases advancing at different rates
Scenery handler: when triggered, after a delay plays smash/hit sounds or an effect and reveals the next records, fading a light slot
Returns the fixed top height 22000 used by the rippling wall (through the out pointer)
Per-frame update of a rippling vertical surface (levels 4 and 0x13): cosine wave heights, shading, texture spin and sound
Per-frame update of a waving surface mesh driven by a source record: spring-followed height, per-vertex sway, glow alpha
Mesh handler: offsets the vertex texture coordinates by a circular wave and runs the texture animation
Mesh handler: scrolls the vertex texture coordinates by a speed from +0x3C (func_15094EC8), caching source UVs once

Plays the collect sound for a pickup kind (+0x54) at the collecting object, with extra voice lines for two character ids
Floating pickup callback: spins, bobs, is taken by the first eligible player in range, then scale/wobble/shrink animation
Sliding/bobbing scenery handler: per motion type moves x/y between rest and open positions or bobs, with move sounds

Scenery handler: carries player +0x84 along an arc toward a target with a temporary camera mode, then hides itself
On level 0x35 for kind 0x8005: places the object at a fixed local offset of world record +0x3E (its matrix)

Four-part door handler: opens/closes in two phases moving this and the next three records apart in y and x
Touch handler: sets the record's trigger state +0x80 to 1 when it is 0
Scenery handler: bobs y with a cosine; once triggered, waits a time and then sinks until hidden below -10000
Copies the position of the world record whose id is byte +0x3F into this record
Clears the linked door group list (D_800DC3F0 = 0)
Registers a door in the linked door group list (up to 4) and syncs open/close states between doors of the same group

Per-frame player look camera: floor test, per-mode defaults, then states move-in / free stick orbit / return, look offset, view rebuild

Sets the look camera's per-mode defaults (+0x190 pitch, +0x784 distance, +0x99C) by player mode +0x23E and level

Empty camera mode handler (does nothing)
Per-frame yaw update of a following player camera (multiplayer, riding, locked cases), then position, orbit and height steps

Camera mode turning the yaw toward a target point (+0x614) with eased rates, then position/orbit/height steps
Third-person camera placement around the target: pitch/yaw/distance, eased eye position with min distance and floor clearance
Camera mode 1 (follow): turns the yaw toward the eye-to-target heading at an eased rate, then orbit, height and position steps
Computes the camera's two lean offsets from its heading and the lean preset; outputs them or eases them into the camera

When the pivot camera system (D_800898F0) is on, resets the player's pivot record in D_800DC458
Camera mode 0x40: target follows a pivot toward the eye at a distance; position eased or snapped, then collision and state flags
Debug free-fly camera driven by the controller: turn, move, climb, pitch, strafe, roll, with speed caps
Camera mode 0x80000: runs the title/menu carousel camera (func_151E73C8) for the player
Camera eye base / floor height of the followed object: floor, water and ceiling checks, eye height, swim bob, minimum eye y
Copies the default viewport rects into the 4 per-player-count tables (halved for split screen, scaled on two levels)
Auto free-camera step: projects the eye to the screen, scans the z-buffer for obstacles and turns/drops the camera target
Runs the auto free-camera step when the camera mode and flags allow it, else resets its state and countdowns
Free-camera z-buffer scan left and right of a screen column to find obstacles on each side of the camera axis
Free-camera reset countdown: while frames remain, clears the z-buffer scan row and counts down; returns 1 then
Updates a free-camera axis record: previous direction, new direction from the position change, threshold and position
Free-camera axis test: below the limit marks the axis blocked with a direction, else resets the axis record
Free-camera turn from the four axis records: picks the blocked side, computes the turn and adjusts distances while it runs
Camera eye collision: eases the probe ellipsoid size and moves a probe object from the old to the new eye position
When the camera is within 42 units of the target horizontally, swings it 45x2 degrees aside and starts the yaw fade-in
Fade-in of +0x5CC up to 1.0, turning +0x384 toward the yaw at that rate; at 1.0 clears flag 2 and sets +0x384 to 999
Empty camera step (does nothing)
Pushes the camera out of a requested collision cylinder, turning it 5 degrees when the push is close to the view direction
Returns 1 (always-true camera predicate)
Builds the gameplay view matrix of a camera controller: eased orbit, look-at, then shake, roll and per-player extra rotation/translation
Applies a sine wobble (x/y scale pulsing) to the camera's view matrix in some modes, with an eased strength
Loads the 4 camera track assets (type 0x1B) into D_800DC6B0 and stores their lengths in 24-byte frames
Starts camera track arg1 on the camera (+0x850 = track, state +0x84D = 1)
Advances the camera track timer (+0x84E) and ends it (state 0) after the track's frame count
Empty camera function (does nothing)
Camera sideways tilt from pad buttons 0/1: tilt angle moves and decays, rotating the eye around the target
Appends an event (type, data) to the camera's 20-slot event queue
Returns the next event of the camera's event queue and advances the read index (wraps at 20)
Clears the camera's event queue (read and write indices to 0)
Says whether the camera's event queue is empty (read index == write index)
Starts a camera shake from preset arg1 (D_80089970: frequencies, phase times, rates) unless the target has its own view
Stops the camera shake: state 5, offsets and amplitude 0, time -1
Per-frame camera shake: sine offsets per axis and roll, amplitude ramping through the preset's phases, reset at the end
Camera eye height: eases the eye height over its base toward the target height (ceiling cut, clamps, water), sets eye y
Camera mode 0x100000: target at player 0 (player 1 for camera 3) head height, eye 60 units behind along its heading
Display list copying one z-buffer row into the camera's depth-row buffer for the free-camera depth scan, then restores state
Per-frame handler of the camera request record (+0x6FC): hold, node-graph follow, fixed positions, look-at and distance modes
Pushes camera mode slot 7 with the current mode and a preset's flag/pitch changes (by preset number)
Calls the level's player state handler D_80089A10[D_800B0DF0 +0xF] (when non-zero) with the camera controller
